tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List all countries supported for IBAN generation, with code, name and IBAN length.

tools.name: generate_iban
tools.description: Generate one or more random, structurally valid (ISO 13616 / MOD-97) test IBANs for a country, with correct national check digits where the country has them. Generated IBANs were not issued by any bank: never use them for payments.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate an IBAN: MOD-97 checksum, expected length and country support.
